recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-3408 unless PA reopens the R6 personal-versus-functional split; stale generated diagram artifacts should be regenerated or reviewed separately rather than handled as a FHIR-3408 source fix.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PA issue asking to change Patient.contact.relationship from a self-defined FHIR value set to the HL7 v2 table 0131 value set, with mother-child relationships represented from the context of RelatedPerson.
initial_application: SVN-era git commit fb14d2fad17858e1b603cb0032db8a62b3563517 names tracker 3408 and changed the old Patient spreadsheet binding reference to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/v2-0131 while adding mother/newborn guidance that uses Patient/RelatedPerson. Later source refactors moved Patient into structuredefinition-Patient.xml and narrative XML.
additional_context: Patient remains an active core resource in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-17472 later created patient-contactrelationship as a table-131-derived value set excluding the v2 'other' code. FHIR-15841, Applied for R6, intentionally changed Patient.contact.relationship to a preferred v3-PersonalRelationshipRoleType binding for personal relationships, added Patient.contact.role for functional roles using relatedperson-relationshiptype, and deprecated/retired patient-contactrelationship. Current Patient notes still preserve the RelatedPerson guidance for mother/newborn administrative relationships.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Rebinding Patient.contact.relationship back to v2 table 0131 would conflict with the later applied FHIR-15841 model, while the current authoritative XML and narrative already retain the parts of FHIR-3408 that remain applicable.
